raw.details:
Overview

Code Auction is a team-based competitive coding event. It combines programming, strategy, and auction-based decision-making, where teams bid virtual currency on programming problems and strategically manage their resources to maximize their scores.

Event Date: 22nd October 2026

Guidelines

  • Each team must consist of 2–4 members.
  • All team members can discuss and solve the purchased problems.
  • Each team receives an equal amount of token currency.
  • Teams must manage their currency strategically between programming problems and Power Cards.
  • The event includes the following Power Cards:
    • Extra Time: Provides additional time for an eligible problem.
    • Hint: Provides a useful hint for an eligible problem.
    • Double Points: Doubles the points earned from an eligible solved problem.
    • Steal: Allows a team to claim an eligible advantage/problem under the event rules.
  • Exact Power Card effects and usage conditions will be announced before the event.
  • Correctly solved problems earn points, and problem difficulty may determine the points awarded.
  • Power Cards may modify scores according to their stated effects.
  • The guidelines do not specify whether inter-college or inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • The number of programming problems and the duration of individual rounds have not been specified.

Rules

  • Teams cannot bid more coins than their available balance.
  • All bids must be placed within the announced bidding time.
  • Power Cards can only be used according to their stated rules and usage conditions.
  • Copying or using unauthorized assistance may lead to disqualification.
  • The team with the highest final score will be declared the winner.
  • The organizers' decision will be final and binding.
